Title: Haven Uncovered w/Form Of Mist Question

Messages.Author: Kevin Lowe
Messages.Body:
This situation came up in a recent game...

A Haven Uncovered has been placed on Ozmo, because everyone hates
Malkavians, and Camille Deveraux (sp?) uses it to attack Ozmo as a +1
stealth action as per HU.

Ozmo runs/ducks/weaves, and Camille runs out of presses before she
torpors Ozmo, but she has a bright idea. "I'll use Form Of Mist, end the
combat and continue with my action (mugging Ozmo) at +1 stealth". What
happens? Form Of Mist was obviously meant by the designers to be used
when an action is blocked, but this seems like it might be legitimate...
If so, the combat would restart.

We decided it wasn't a legal move at the time, but is there an official
opinion (or better yet an unofficial consensus)? I assume this _must_ have
come up in connection with Gangrels and Bum's Rush in the past...

Kevin Lowe.

Messages.Author: Shane Travis
Messages.Body:
Kevin Lowe (ml32...@student.uq.edu.au) wrote:

: Ozmo runs/ducks/weaves, and Camille runs out of presses before she

: torpors Ozmo, but she has a bright idea. "I'll use Form Of Mist, end the
: combat and continue with my action (mugging Ozmo) at +1 stealth". What
: happens? Form Of Mist was obviously meant by the designers to be used
: when an action is blocked, but this seems like it might be legitimate...
: If so, the combat would restart.

I agree with you about how the designers probably intended it (note the
'as if unblocked' phrase on there) but can see no reason (that related to
the cards) why Camille can't pull this trick. Nothin I know of stops her.

Note that without the benefit of other cards, this would have exactly the
same effect as letting the combat go to its normal conclusion; instead of
getting that lat strike, she S:CE with the FoM, then gets one strike in
the next combat. If you've a Mob Connections on play, or picked up a
Trap after the opening round, you would be free to whale away on poor Ozmo...

This seems like a semi-fair tradeoff to me: Camille is using up a
valuable card, and Ozmo's Meth has another opportunity to block (he's
been picking up cards too, presumably). I would have less problems with
it if the FoM were fixed somehow - possibly as per Curt's suggestion and
had a vampire-blood cost of 1 added to it. This way, Camille would be
_paying_ for the opportunity.

Intellectually - Evil, sneaky, imaginative... I LIKE it!
Legally - can't seem to find a problem with it.
Ethically - eh... Definitely making use of a broken card...

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Kevin Lowe <ml32...@student.uq.edu.au> wrote:
>Ozmo runs/ducks/weaves, and Camille runs out of presses before she
>torpors Ozmo, but she has a bright idea. "I'll use Form Of Mist, end the
>combat and continue with my action (mugging Ozmo) at +1 stealth". What
>happens? Form Of Mist was obviously meant by the designers to be used
>when an action is blocked, but this seems like it might be legitimate...
>If so, the combat would restart.

From the way you phrased the question, I'm going to say "not legal",
because using superior Form of Mist is a strike, and it sounds like
Camille was searching for options during the press step of the round.
But if Camille has a strike available and anticipates being unable to
press successfully, then she can strike to end combat and continue the
action, even though it wasn't blocked in the first place.

>
>The action continues and a new combat begins, yes. I don't think I'd
>call it "backing up", though.

Unless Bum's Rush normally initiates two combats, you'll have to back up
to the point of "Enter Combat" if you want another combat to begin.
Form of Mist certainly does not cause a combat (It tends to avoid it :-).

I'd like to see the outline (a la Complete Rules Outline) that would
allow Bum's Rush to resolve with two combats (barring re-combat effects
like Psyche and Hidden Lurker) without "Backing Up".

Messages.Author: Jack9C
Messages.Body:
After an action is successful (i.e. a Bum's Rush) then any card (i.e. Form
of Mist <sup>) which modifies the attempt at the action does not modify
the attempt at the action. The Bum's Rush was successful, therefore you
cannot continue on Bum's Rushing at +1 afterward. The Form of Mist
-continue on at +1 stealth text would be ignored.
